description: EXP-1188: what a tapped markdown link in agent prose (narration, Guide, thread) opens. classifyAppLink(href, origin): trim; '' → ignore. A '/'-path (not '//') resolves against the instance origin. 'mailto:' → external as given. 'http(s)://' needs a valid authority ([A-Za-z0-9-] labels joined by '.', at least two labels unless the host is 'localhost' (case-insensitive), optional ':port', no userinfo), else ignore (browsers punycode a placeholder like 'https://…' into a one-label host); scheme+authority equal to origin (case-insensitive) = in-app, else external with the href as given. Anything else (other schemes, '//', '#x', bare words) → ignore. In-app paths split on '/' (query + hash dropped, empty segments dropped, each segment percent-decoded): ['t',team,'boards',board,'issues',identifier] → issue, ['t',team,'sessions',id] → session, otherwise app with the path as written (query + hash kept; an absolute URL's path = everything after the authority, '/'-prefixed when it does not start with '/'). Locked ×4: web lib/app-link.ts, desktop domain::app_link, iOS ExpCore AppLink.swift, Android domain/AppLink.kt.
